title: Vulture
wikitext:
[[image:vulture.png|thumb|]]

A large, carnivorous, scavenger bird that also goes by the name "Buzzard" or "Carrion Bird". They usually have featherless heads and broad, slow-flapping wingspans.  Vultures are sometimes found lurking about the bones of dead beasts and ill-managed graveyards.  They can be found in [[Mulgore]], [[Westfall]], [[Tanaris]], the [[Arathi Highlands]], the [[Badlands]], the [[Blasted Lands]], [[Thousand Needles]], [[Desolace]], and the [[Redridge Mountains]].  

Additional notes:
* Vultures are [[hostile]] [[beast]]s that will attack [[player]]s that venture too close.
* Most vultures have a knock-down ability called Swoop that interrupts attacks by characters and requires time for them to get up after being knocked down.

== As A [[Hunter]] Pet ==
* Have medium HP, medium armor, and medium damage.
* Eats only Meat and Fish.
* Can learn [[Dive]], [[Bite]], [[Claw]], [[Cower]], [[Growl]], and their special skill, [[Screech.]] 
* Excellent as a pet, due to their variety of skills, their area of effect taunt (Screech), and their overall stats.  The Spiteflayer, a rare spawn in the Blasted Lands, has a blazing 1.2 attack speed.
* Not seen very often as a Hunter pet.
